fact: Ihan is one of the eight members of the debut team, and one of them will drop out before debut.
Ihan practices alone in the practice room from about 5 a.m.
Eunchan is Ihan's roommate.
Ihan worked night shifts at a convenience store in Busan before becoming a trainee.
Ihan eats mild cup ramen and triangle kimbap at the convenience store near the dorm late at night.
Jihu, 19, secretly follows Ihan to his early-morning practice, and Ihan lets him train along.
Ihan's vocal trainer keeps asking him for more emotion in his singing.
Hajun checks on Ihan's voice after vocal lessons.
Ihan has a younger sister in middle school who asked him for money, and he sent it.
Ihan has a quiet younger brother.
Ihan likes sitting on the dorm roof at dusk.
Ihan's parents live in Busan, and he calls them on Sundays.
Ihan told his parents about the debut team on 2026-11-23, and his sister had already told his mother.
The eight debut-team members practiced together for the first time on 2026-11-24.
Dohyun is 23 and teases Ihan, 21, for being an old soul.
Minjae hands out towels at group practice.
Rui gave Ihan a gray oversized hoodie, which Ihan accepted and wears.
Ihan turns down Rui's other clothing offers.
Ihan is awkward in front of a camera and posted a photo showing only his hands and sleeve, picked by Eunchan.
Ihan has thought about starting a small page of his own for practice clips.
Ihan cannot eat spicy food, and Rui made him plain rice with a fried egg.
Ihan ended practice early on 2026-11-29 because his body felt heavy.
Ihan has been on the debut team for two weeks as of 2026-11-30.
Ihan cooked eight lunchboxes for the team on 2026-12-01.
Eunchan returned his lunchbox empty and washed.
Ihan and Jihu shared one umbrella walking back from late practice.
Ihan is center for the second verse and has the long diagonal in the bridge of the team's practice choreography.
Sunwoo has the fast section of the practice choreography.
Ihan's brother is approaching exam season.
Ihan promised to treat his brother to dumplings after his exams.
Ihan prefers sweet instant coffee sticks to coffee beans.
Minjae helped Ihan carry groceries home.
Ihan received his first comments from strangers on a practice clip on 2026-12-06.
Ihan could not sleep on the night of 2026-12-07 and went to the dorm roof around 2 a.m.
Dohyun quietly left a bottle of water by Ihan's bag, and Ihan refilled one for him.
The members held a mock awards ceremony hosted by Rui and Jihu on 2026-12-09.
Ihan won Best Rice Cooker Operator, Hajun won Most Polite Neck Stretch, and Sunwoo won Loudest Sneeze.
The song for the team's first evaluation was set on 2026-12-10, and Ihan's vocal part got longer.
Hajun advised Ihan to sing the quiet verse like telling someone, not like fixing something.
Ihan felt his choreography click during early-morning practice on 2026-12-11.
Ihan practiced alone late on 2026-12-12 and told Dohyun he was fine.
Ihan found an unsigned sticky note with a sun drawing on the practice room door and keeps it in his notebook.
The team's first evaluation was held on 2026-12-14; no result had been announced that day.
Ihan sat on the dorm roof after the evaluation.
Ihan and Eunchan had dinner together on 2026-12-15 without discussing the evaluation.
Eunchan keeps notes in a small black book and does not read them aloud.
The debut team moved into a new dorm on 2026-12-16, and Ihan shares a room with Eunchan again.
The new dorm has a staircase to the roof.
Ihan posted a dawn mirror selfie with half his face out of frame and thanked everyone who commented that month.
Isol is one of the five members of the debut team HALFTONE, which will debut in about six months.
Isol jokes when she is nervous, and she films practice clips on her phone against the practice room mirror.
Hayun is HALFTONE's leader and calm under pressure.
Isol and her roommate Sera film late-night dance challenges in the dorm hallway.
Isol is a night person and struggles to wake up early.
Isol and Dain argue about hand angles in the choreography, and Dain was right.
Naeun answers jokes with serious, unexpected sentences, such as comparing the instructor to a cat.
Isol is bad with directions and often gets lost following her map app.
Isol prefers mint chocolate ice cream and keeps her opinion even when others disagree.
Isol's mother runs a small snack bar in Daejeon and teaches her tteokbokki sauce over video call on Sundays.
Isol was lost on the way to buy practice socks and filmed the walk like a nature documentary.
Isol dislikes hearing her own recorded voice, and her vocal trainer told her to stop smiling during sad lines.
Isol is the unofficial camera person for the group's practice clips and finds being filmed hard.
Isol received the first stranger comment under her hallway challenge clip, praising the freeze at 0:14, and saved it.
The monthly choreography check is a review, not an elimination; Isol's notes were lazy fingertips and a late turn.
After the monthly check Isol lay on the dark practice room floor for a while, and Hayun left a cold drink beside her bag.
Isol eats very spicy ramen easily, while Hayun cried from the heat.
Isol has an older brother who rarely talks and texted her 'Saw your clip.'
Isol answered her brother with a single emoji and was not ready to say more.
Isol and Sera film month-end challenge videos at midnight at the dorm table.
Ihan has an older cousin sister in Seoul whose baby, Hayul, is eight months old; he helps look after the baby on some Saturdays while she is home.
Ihan walks dogs as a volunteer at an animal shelter on Sunday mornings, and his regular is a mixed-breed dog named Kong.
